body:
Saved native radiation already contained enough information to recover the missing endpoint atomic stocks. This change uses incoming/average/outgoing virtual-bin traces to invert opacity and recover source-effective x1s, x2s, and x2p at native knots 5126 and 5127, then computes the new finite net/outgoing Lyα measure and transports it with the existing B3g operator.

Science S1: 0bdbd2ad1357c4b3141d3488a94534d082d1a0cf
S0 contract/source checkpoint: fd3524e914d6bec70f30e2a5643134e956cbba0a
Independent review: PASS_SCOPED_NUMERICAL_RECONSTRUCTION_AND_PHOTON_RETURN after one targeted pre-execution interval-propagation repair.

Results:
- x1s: 0.8549423676545932 → 0.8550700033096545; primary right-snapshot relative residual 7.92e-15.
- Net ΔN0 = 23.46391833488862 m^-3; net ΔU0 = 3.8342003535474504e-17 J/m^3.
- Independent 70-digit net comparisons are below 2.03e-14 on the net quantities’ own scales.
- Upper QSS endpoint storage defect = -3.922015722821008e-9 m^-3.

Validation: one new controls invocation (20 checks), one new result invocation (82 checks), one saved-result plot; all exit 0. Recorded child CPU 5.377854 s and wall 5.460340094 s. No native solver or old tests/consume/plot replay. Existing 512 cohorts, two old B3i RHS consumptions, incoming tube and historical budget records are reused.

The source-effective endpoint reconstruction and represented finite photon return are admitted. A full physical atomic transaction and new B3i consumption remain open because finite QSS storage/refill energy ownership is not yet physically bound. T and four-force remain separate; all physical radii remain null. Original central DAG remains 27/88, delta 0.

Publication and delivery are complete:
- Science S1: 0bdbd2ad1357c4b3141d3488a94534d082d1a0cf
- Delivery D1: 5ae9dcbc6fc0765aa1762fb8bb6f031837ae6ff4
- Final receipt/handoff F: 6bf4a5d90b05f7e583be698854e521d259287837
- Additive central M: 152b82cac23fedcb75a9effe0c159bae3d800c01, parent 1a38f94fa50c763bb9df6ccc8ba569f287fe97d5. CR_N5 and CR proper-injection updates, all other 87 nodes and 17 edges are preserved.

Selected R1–R10/C1–C10 work and source/backup coverage: 20/20. Original central DAG: 27/88, delta 0. Stages share S0/S1/D1 checkpoints and two archives; this is not a claim of twenty separate commits or archives.

Final source ZIP: BASS_B3H_HISTORY_INVERSE_S1_DELIVERY_20261027.zip; 3,979,095 bytes; 103 members; SHA256 1174383fa9cbbbf8b45f0f5ccbab45f6bfad1705e16e0b495cf690e9f617876b. The immutable archive predates its own upload receipts; post-archive ACKs are recorded at F without regenerating the archive.
